title: Geography
description: ISC Class XI Geography: the physical and human geography of the world and India.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - Geography (subject code 853) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted February 2025 Geography (853) syllabus document carrying the ISC Year 2027 heading and a CLASS XI section, read through its AglaSem reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with the Oswal Publishers 2026-27 page as corroboration. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (70 marks) and Paper II Practical Work and Project Work (30 marks). The first prescribed topic, 'Geography - its interdisciplinary approach and future prospects', is marked 'not to be tested' in the syllabus and is therefore not registered as a chapter.
